name: KB Solar Manufacturer - Wholesaler - Distributor
old_description: Enjoy expedited delivery and installation services thanks to our local manufacturing facility. We ensure your solar panel orders, regardless of size, are fulfilled swiftly, reducing downtime and accelerating your project’s completion.
about:
KB Solar operates from Spartanburg, South Carolina, where brothers Ivan and Alex Karastanov founded the company as a family-driven venture. The name KB stands for Karastanov Brothers, reflecting the hands-on leadership that guides the business. From the start, their mission centered on producing high-quality, locally-made solar panels that combine performance with affordability.

The company runs a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility where it fabricates solar panels using cutting-edge technology and rigorous quality control processes. Beyond panel production, KB Solar functions as an electrical contractor and solar installer, offering custom solar solutions, design consultation, and full installation services for residential and commercial projects. The local facility enables quick turnaround on orders of any size.

KB Solar serves three primary customer groups: homeowners, business owners, and dealers. Testimonials highlight projects for private residences and commercial operations, including a reference from Practical Preppers, a business that values the firm's dual role as manufacturer and installer. The dealer program extends the company's reach through a network of partners.

The founders established KB Solar to advance a sustainable future while supporting the South Carolina economy through local jobs. The company differentiates itself with USA-made panels sold at direct-from-manufacturer prices, a dedicated representative assigned from consultation through post-installation support, and a commitment to stringent quality controls at every production stage.
